text:
alex: Hey — PR #9382 is ready but Windows e2e is flaky on the kv cache eviction test. Failing on the same test on master too. Can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/9382
ci-bot: Buildkite build #4321 failed on windows-e2e (job: windows-e2e/agent-7). Test: kv_cache_eviction_test::eviction_does_not_oom. Logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra/builds/4321
tara: on it, pinging windows infra folks. can you paste the failing snippet?
alex: here: ```
[ RUN      ] kv_cache_eviction_test.eviction_does_not_oom
=================================================================
== SEGFAULT (AddressSanitizer) ==
Invalid write of size 8 at 0x7ffd8f2b
Address 0x7ffd8f2b is stack'd, ptr=0x7ffd8f28
SUMMARY: AddressSanitizer: SEGV in eviction_worker
---> 0x7ffd8f2b in eviction_worker()
Thread 1 (tid 12345, running)
````
milo: looks like a use-after-free in the eviction callback. i've seen a similar race when eviction runs concurrently with shutdown on windows. @jen any memory of a recent refactor that touched that path?
jen: yeah we changed the eviction queue timing in #9204. could be related. i can try a bisect tomorrow but low bandwidth today. if someone can repro locally with the same test we can iterate faster.
tara: queued a rerun now. 
ci-bot: Re-run triggered by tara (user). Build #4322 started (windows-e2e).
ci-bot: Build #4322 failed again — same test, same stack.
milo: ok that narrows it down. plan A: bisect to the offending commit. Plan B (short): xfail this test on windows, merge the PR if everything else is green, then follow up with a fix/bisect.
alex: i prefer avoid blocking the PR if it's unrelated to the feature. i'll add a note and flaky label and create a follow-up issue.
tara: SGTM. can you add the `xfail-windows` label in the PR and a short comment pointing to the follow-up issue?
alex: done — added `flaky/windows` and comment + created issue #1845. thanks for the quick eyes :thumbsup:
milo: cheers. tagging @jen to pick up the bisect when you have cycles.
jen: will take it tomorrow.
alex: merging once CI passes for non-windows lanes. thanks all!
